scripts.check:root: pnpm run check:rules && pnpm run check:boundaries && pnpm --filter @imsweb/web run design:lint && sh -n scripts/migration/activate-node-release.sh && bash -n scripts/deployment/deploy-compose-release.sh scripts/deployment/run-authenticated-compose-release.sh && node --check scripts/migration/preflight-node-release.cjs && node --check scripts/development/dev-environment.mjs
scripts.check:pre-commit: git diff --cached --check && pnpm run check:root && pnpm --filter @imsweb/web run lint && pnpm --filter @imsweb/web run typecheck && pnpm --filter @imsweb/api run syntax && pnpm --filter @imsweb/api run check:architecture
scripts.build: pnpm run check:boundaries && pnpm --filter @imsweb/web run build && pnpm --filter @imsweb/api run build && pnpm --filter @imsweb/api run build:client
scripts.check: pnpm run check:root && pnpm run check:web && pnpm run check:api && pnpm --filter @imsweb/api run check:assets
scripts.test:web-routing: pnpm --filter @imsweb/web run build && pnpm --filter @imsweb/api run build && pnpm --filter @imsweb/api run test:web-routing
scripts.test:infra: node --test tests/development-environment.test.js && python3 -m unittest tests/test_agent_rules.py tests/test_git_hooks.py tests/test_release_activation.py tests/test_github_deployment.py tests/test_operations_docs.py tests/test_compose_deployment.py tests/test_workspace_boundaries.py
scripts.test: pnpm run check:root && pnpm run test:infra && pnpm run test:api && pnpm --filter @imsweb/web run test:unit && pnpm run test:web-routing
scripts.dev:rustfs:up: docker compose --profile local-storage -f deploy/compose.yaml up -d rustfs rustfs-init
scripts.dev:rustfs:down: docker compose --profile local-storage -f deploy/compose.yaml stop rustfs
scripts.dev:api:up: docker compose --profile local-storage -f deploy/compose.yaml up -d --build api
scripts.dev:api:r2:up: docker compose --env-file apps/api/.env -f deploy/compose.yaml up -d --build api
